HediffDef.label: starved life force
HediffDef.description: The Wraith's usable Life Force has fallen into a critical reserve. Movement, manipulation and consciousness all degrade while regenerative capacity is sharply constrained.

HediffDef.label: life-force collapse
HediffDef.description: Almost no usable Life Force remains. The body has dropped into a barely active survival condition that is not itself fatal but leaves the Wraith nearly unable to act until vitality is restored.

HediffDef.label: deep Wraith hibernation
HediffDef.description: The Wraith has intentionally reduced its body to a near-inert state. Life Force expenditure falls dramatically, trading almost all movement and manipulation for long-term survival.

HediffDef.label: feeding trauma
HediffDef.description: A Wraith feeding has stripped away a large portion of this pawn's vitality. The immediate physical weakness fades over time, but the biological aging remains and another full feeding before recovery can be fatal.

HediffDef.label: recently fed
HediffDef.description: Recently acquired vitality is still stabilizing through the Wraith's tissues. This temporary marker records a fresh feeding event while the Life Force reserve settles.

HediffDef.label: wraith experiment subject
HediffDef.description: Invasive Wraith examination has left temporary neurological and motor disruption. The subject remains the same prisoner and retains normal custody and identity.

HediffDef.label: wraith experimental insight
HediffDef.description: Recent observations from a living captive have temporarily sharpened this Wraith's understanding of biological systems.
